sentences.text: This is a petition filed by the petitioner under Section 528 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashing of the FIR No. 49/2017 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC registered at Police Station Nanakpura.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
5. Let status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
Nominal roll be also called from the jail authorities.

6. List on 04.09.2025.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J MAY 29, 2025/SV
